name: soul-reaper
author: BlaXun
description: Soul Reaper in pre-renewal, as the Soul Linker's rebirth. A Soul Linker at 99/50 is reborn as a Novice, becomes a Taekwon again with transcendent stat points, and from Taekwon job 40 becomes a Soul Reaper, to job 70: the same skill points and gear rules as any transcendent class. The skills are scaled to sit a little below the transcendent classes, and four tiers of Soul Reaper gear (levels 50 to 95) drop from monsters.
